definitions.explanation: A tubular structure that carries blood through the body.

examples.japanese: {血管|けっかん}が{詰|つ}まると{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous when blood vessels get blocked.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}は{血管|けっかん}を{丈夫|じょうぶ}にする。
{医者|いしゃ}は{血管|けっかん}に{注射|ちゅうしゃ}をした。
examples.english: The doctor gave an injection into the blood vessel.

notes:
{血管|けっかん} refers to blood vessels in the body.

TYPES OF BLOOD VESSELS:
- {動脈|どうみゃく} (artery)
- {静脈|じょうみゃく} (vein)
- {毛細|もうさい}{血管|けっかん} (capillary)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {血管|けっかん}が{詰|つ}まる (blood vessel gets blocked)
- {血管|けっかん}が{切|き}れる (blood vessel ruptures)
- {血管|けっかん}を{広|ひろ}げる (to dilate blood vessels)

RELATED TERMS:
- {血管|けっかん}{疾患|しっかん} (vascular disease)
- {心臓|しんぞう}{血管|けっかん} (cardiovascular)
